Title: Lutz von Hohenzollern and Ancilla Empowerment

Messages.Author: Are13
Messages.Body:
Hello.

I am calling Ancilla Empowerment with Lutz von Hohenzollern. My prey
has 3 minions and 4 pool. My grandprey has 4 minions and 2 pool. What
happens and why if the referendum passes?

Lutz von Hohenzollern
Clan: Malkavian (group 4)
Capacity: 11
Disciplines: AUS DEM OBF PRE pot
Camarilla Malkavian Inner Circle: While Lutz is ready, your prey burns
a pool each time the referendum of a political action passes. +2
bleed.

Ancilla Empowerment
Type: Political Action
Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each
minion he or she controls.

I assume both get ousted with 1 point to me and 1 point to my prey.
But I am not that sure after some thread here, saying if I oust my
prey with eg. KRC from 3 pool, my next prey would take 1 pool damage
from Lutz.

Messages.Author: Are13
Messages.Body:
From the rulebook: "Resolve the referendum. If there are more votes
for the referendum than against, the referendum passes, and the
effects of the successful referendum take place." Both Lutz and
effects of referendum happen if the referendum passes. I see no window
for anything else to happen between like people getting ousted and
gaining pool. If there is one, please explain why.

Messages.Author: Wookie813
Messages.Body:


Your prey burns one pool when the referendum passes, and the terms of
the referendum are applied. I believe this happens at the same time
(as though Lutz's special text is an addition to the terms). Your prey
and grandprey are ousted. You gain six pool and a victory point. Your
prey gains a victory point, but cannot collect the six pool, as s/he
is ousted.

The rulebook says when the 6 pool is applied: when the prey is ousted
(assuming the would-be pool-gainer is not also ousted).

A (me): Lutz and more pool than minions.
B (prey): 4 pool, 3 minions
C (grandprey): 2 pool, 4 minions

Ancillae Empowerment:

A loses some, but is not ousted
B loses 3, has 1
C loses 4, has 0 (-2)

=> C is ousted (before Lutz, per links given above); B gains 6, has 7

B loses 1 for Lutz's special, has 6.

> Waiting for sunrise in the US

Correct. (Much more effect than the presence/absence of "LSJ" in the
subject line).
